description: This PHP source file defines the ClientRepository class within the OAuth2 system of the project. It implements methods to retrieve and validate OAuth2 client entities using a bean manager and client entity objects.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Implements the OAuth2 ClientRepositoryInterface, managing OAuth2 client data retrieval and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client entity and bean manager dependencies.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves and populates the client entity based on the provided client identifier.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates the client credentials and grant type against stored client data.
